name: room
text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: Adopt the 4px #005fcc outer ring with a 2px white inner ring for focus indicators. This ensures 7:1 contrast on dark backgrounds and meets WCAG 2.2 AA for keyboard users. The trade-off is slightly larger focus rings, but it guarantees visibility for users with low vision or color blindness.

name: Reader
text: The 4px #005fcc ring risks blending into light patterned backgrounds where #005fcc | A 3px #fff ring alone fails on dark patterned backgrounds. Settle it by testing both rings on a live EXCAVA demo with real patterned backgrounds—measure contrast ratios and user visibility.
